description: The shell's own pages (the manager window) get every app command. No remote context here — ship-served content is covered by workspace-remote only. notification:default is the notification plugin's own permission set; the notifier raises everything from Rust, but the plugin's permission is what carries the OS-level authorisation (on macOS the request prompt), and granting it to the shell's page rather than to the ship-served one keeps the decision about what pops up on this machine entirely in this binary.
